properties.name: appconfig.application
properties.description: AWS AppConfig application name. Can be omitted when the spring.config.import location contains the application name.

properties.name: appconfig.profile
properties.description: AWS AppConfig configuration profile name. Defaults to the application name. Note that this is not a Spring profile.

properties.name: appconfig.region
properties.description: AWS region used to call AppConfig. When omitted the AWS SDK default region provider chain is used.

properties.name: appconfig.endpoint
properties.description: Custom AWS AppConfig endpoint, for example when using LocalStack.

properties.name: appconfig.content-type
properties.description: Format of the hosted configuration: yaml, json or properties. When omitted the Content-Type returned by AppConfig is used, falling back to yaml.

properties.name: appconfig.minimum-poll-interval
properties.description: Minimum poll interval sent when starting an AppConfig configuration session. Must be at least 15 seconds.

properties.name: appconfig.prefix
properties.description: Optional prefix added to every property name loaded from AppConfig.

properties.name: appconfig.fail-fast
properties.description: Whether a failure to read AppConfig should stop application startup. Optional locations are always ignored when not found.

properties.name: appconfig.refresh.enabled
properties.description: Whether to poll AppConfig and refresh the application context when the configuration changes. Requires Spring Cloud Context; enabled by default when it is present.

properties.name: appconfig.refresh.interval
properties.description: Time between AppConfig polls. Keep this at or above appconfig.minimum-poll-interval.
